item.title: Iran drill to focus on Strait of Hormuz as tension builds
item.description: Tehran has issued a warning to maritime traffic regarding upcoming live-fire naval exercises in the Strait of Hormuz. According to The Associated Press, the drills involve "naval shooting" and could impact 20% of global oil transit. Iran further cautioned that the region is "fair game" if it is targeted, per The Wall Street Journal.
